job: Put details beside the thing they describe, in two columns.
purpose: A main area with a 320px panel at its end, or a nav at its start. Below 760px of page width the panel stacks under, or above, the content. With data-grow, a split that is the only child of a growing band fills its height.
useWhen: A list or run needs a details panel beside it.
Settings pages have a section nav at the start and a form beside it.

avoidWhen.when: Equal columns of cards or tiles.
Details that should cover the page while open.

variants.useWhen: The secondary column sits at the start, as a settings nav does.
